entities.summary: Ibrahim Riahi, birth name Abou Ishak Ibrahim Ben Abdelkader Riahi, was a Tunisian ambassador, theologian and saint. A Sunni Muslim scholar, he was also a poet. He was the grandfather of Ali Riahi.
